title: ICS cytokine skew re-analysis of the Michaelis deposit
protocol: Recompute, from the deposited FlowJo gates, each donor's CD4+ IFNg/IL-4/IL-10/IL-17 response to the C9orf72 peptide pool minus vehicle, and compare the ratio IFNg/(IL-4+IL-10) between ALS and healthy donors.
cost_rationale: two local files, no new acquisition

title: ICS cytokine skew re-analysis, declared with the controlled metadata keys
protocol: Same as EXP-1, with required_metadata named by the exact fcs_file_name_group_label / fcs_file_name_condition_label / flowjo_donor_group keys data_describe reports for this deposit, as pl-prod-009's own designers should have been told to do.
cost_rationale: two local files, no new acquisition
